checkedAlternates.risk: Accumulators often contain a piston or bladder.
checkedAlternates.resolution: An accumulator stores pressurized fluid energy (group-1), rather than performing mechanical work on a load like actuators (group-3).
A relief valve opens to vent excess pressure as a control valve (group-4).
